correctness.rationale: For a size-three stable class, regularity forces a cyclic triangle; size-two classes are impossible. The cross-arc matrix of two such classes has constant row and column sums; nonuniform cases are perfect matchings or complements. Automorphisms are classwise triangle rotations, with t_Q=sign(pi_PQ)t_P in Z/3, and every compatible system preserves all arcs. Path transport yields one C3 factor exactly for each balanced signed-graph component. Negative cycles force all exponents to zero. The 9-vertex witness has three distinct degree classes and a negative signed triangle; extensions preserve the obstruction. Reconstructed symbolic proof, checked boundaries; the embedded verifier enumerates 2744 pattern systems and confirms 2310 in-scope by direct automorphism tests.

value.rationale: This is an exact natural classification of when counting colors recover all automorphism orbits, with explicit full automorphism group, across an unbounded family of finite tournaments. It converts global automorphism computation into a finite signed-graph balance test. The 9-vertex sharp obstruction and rigid tail show an intrinsic counting-logic limitation and have mathematical motivation beyond a finite table.
